This mechanism has the key property that my Obtainable Schools set is fixed regardless of how I rank schools—it only determines which school within that set I receive. This is characteristic of strategy-proof mechanisms like Deferred Acceptance (DA), where truth-telling is a dominant strategy.

Since my ranking cannot change which schools are obtainable to me, but only determines which one I get among those obtainable, the optimal strategy is to rank my true preferences honestly. This way, I guarantee getting my most preferred school among whatever is obtainable to me.

My true preference order is: y > w > x > z

Given my priorities (w:1, x:2, y:1, z:2), I have top priority at w and y, which are strong positions. Since y is my top choice AND I have top priority there, and w is my second choice with top priority there too, truthful reporting serves me well—if y is obtainable, I get it; if not, w should be obtainable given my priority there.

There's no incentive to misrepresent since the obtainable set is fixed independent of my report. Reporting truthfully ensures I select my best possible outcome from that fixed set.
